contract: Actionable alt-data axis for the Mastermind bot. Each signal: signal_score 0-100 (composite of weighted convergence + brain conviction + price confirm − extension), action ∈ {ACCUMULATE,WATCH,AVOID}, direction ∈ {long,short,neutral}, source ∈ {brain,deterministic}. The bot sizes through its OWN risk framework; this is an input, not an order. Brain calls are graded vs SPY (see calibration). An extended name is never ACCUMULATE. trump_linked / affiliations flag actor ties. rolling_over names (off_high≤−15% AND 20d<0 AND below 50dma) appear in broken_signals only — crowd attention, NOT entries. entry_tier (T1/T2/T3) = validated confluence buy gate signal.
regime_read: Today's pack shows a crowded mega-cap AI complex (MSFT, NVDA, META, GOOGL) with broad affiliation and analyst-bull convergence but weak relative strength — smart-money channels are present, yet no endorsement from price. The cleanest independent alignment is outside the AI trade: T shows genuine multi-channel policy accumulation (congress cluster + government-contract acceleration + lobbying), and AVOID flags on RSG's Trump-sell plus LUV's thin activist read.

calibration.note: No theses scored yet — the track record begins once the first check-by dates pass. Keep conviction modest until it does.

signals.thesis: RSG is a conflicting-signal case: a large insider buying cluster (19 buyers, $262.7M net [insider_cluster]) conflicts directly with a Trump-channel sell signal [trump: side='sell']. The Trump actor network has been the single most predictive component of this desk's alt-data history, and when it diverges from other channels, the trump signal has historically been the one that matters. The insider cluster may be routine option exercise or estate planning, not directional accumulation. AVOID until the divergence resolves.
